info.title: PackProof Public API
info.description: One Proof, one API, many interfaces. API keys are scoped to a tenant and act as its owner. First-party account authentication is required to manage keys. Sandbox and live are separate tenant namespaces; use a separate staging deployment for untrusted experiments.

items.description: Authoritative lines, retained before Proof creation. Existing itemTitle remains required. If quantity is supplied, it must equal the sum of line quantities; otherwise the sum is used. Unit values are declared major currency units.

post.summary: Create a bound capture launch intent
post.description: Private capture-platform candidate. Requires evidence:write and encrypted idempotency storage. The tenant owner redeems the opaque token once using first-party authentication. Allowed surface names do not certify an adapter. Tokens expire after ten minutes; replaying this API request returns the original token and expiry.

201.description: Single-use opaque launch intent. Keep tokens out of logs and query strings.

post.description: Opt-in future.v1 extension. Required scope: proofs:write. Disabled by default; explicit tenant canary required. Write pause blocks POST while preserving GET. Frozen release endpoints remain unchanged. Snapshot scope is sealed records only; offline freshness is unknown.

201.description: Durably accepted and resolved or awaiting user action

post.description: Maximum UTF-8 JSON request body: 65536 bytes. Actor/clientSubmissionId exact request-hash replay returns 200; changed payload returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. 202 only means durable acceptance. A scoped session can only replay its own submissions. Input cannot assign owner, tenant, provenance or Proof status. Only application/json request bodies are accepted (415 otherwise). Scoped-session receipts omit candidate order summaries; the signed-in host retrieves candidates with its normal account token.

get.summary: List up to 50 unresolved account submissions

token.description: Returned once; store only in the dedicated shared Keychain access group.

post.description: An account token may revoke any owned session. An intake-only session may revoke only itself; this supports immediate cleanup when the host account changes during session minting.

get.description: Requires SYSTEM_ADMIN. Study configuration and actual consent define availability. Never returns raw account/Proof IDs. Existing bounded admin period/from/to parser applies.

post.summary: Check and reserve the existing Proof allowance before desktop recording
post.description: First-party account endpoint. Requires the current seller and a writable packing Proof. Atomically reuses the immutable Proof allowance reservation and returns bounded recorder limits. Does not issue a camera session, take payment, create recording evidence or independently verify recording time. Desktop original registration remains post-capture and rechecks acceptance. Unsupported and denied online requests must not be treated as offline permission.

200.description: Account-authorized limits; reservation is keyed to this Proof and reused by retries and later registration.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Opaque signed cursor, seven-day expiry; 410 requires authorized snapshot resync and event-ID deduplication.

200.description: Success. Capture capability and credential responses are sensitive and no-store.

get.summary: Read independently authenticated envelope key history
get.description: Opt-in public HTTPS projection of the current authority-signed registry. Issuer and authority pins are deployment configuration. Responses use no-store; stale or untrusted material fails closed. Consumers must authenticate the endpoint independently of a received package.

503.description: Current independently authenticated key history is unavailable

200.description: Indexed, authorized results; capture time is server receipt time.

AccountBearer.description: PackProof account access token. Intake scoped sessions may only create submissions and read receipts issued to that session.

Error.description: Domain error. 400 invalid request, 401 bad key, 403 scope/role, 404 inaccessible object, 409 immutable/idempotency conflict, 413 limit, 422 failed domain validation, 429 rate limit, 503 unavailable configuration.

canonicalJson.description: Exact signed packproof.sorted-json.v1 index. Includes transactionId, nullable tenantId, purpose, cutoffAt, root, sealed inventory, watermark and bounded limitations.
Stored legacy bytes; never serialized under a new profile.

returnTarget.description: Server-derived canonical Proof path, never an arbitrary external URL.

interaction.description: Client observations only. evidence_committed and proof_finalized are rejected; only canonical server history establishes those outcomes.

StudyTimingCheckpoint.description: Current account/dataset consent required. Clocks are self-reported; duration counters cannot regress. uploadState requires interaction=upload_state_changed. Stable nonce retries return the original response; changed facts reject.

FirstExperienceReport.description: Read-only account/dataset pseudonymous cohort. Full 24-hour window required; withdrawal censors, failures remain. This is not all-customer conversion. Client timings are not app-controlled overhead; server outcomes derive from eligible committed-video/final-manifest history.
